int_name: N RANDOLPH ST & W TIOGA ST

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with sidewalks but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control signage. The roadway surface is degraded with visible cracking and patching, and parked vehicles near the corner create potential sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection to guide pedestrians or alert drivers.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and uneven, posing a trip hazard and affecting vehicle handling.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street are positioned close to the intersection, potentially hiding pedestrians from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the corners for accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines between all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a basic sidewalk and a faded marked crosswalk at an uncontrolled intersection. The lack of modern safety infrastructure like high-visibility markings, pedestrian signals, or curb ramps increases exposure risk for people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the roadway in the center-right foreground

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vegetation
hazards.description: Large trees and dense foliage on the left corner may obscure pedestrians from the view of drivers approaching from that side.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the corner

hazards.name: Degraded Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement near the crossing area can create tripping hazards or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and bring pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars or trees.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and properly sloped curb ramps to ensure the crossing is accessible.

result.summary: The intersection features a faded zebra crosswalk and a stop sign in an industrial/commercial setting. Pedestrian safety is compromised by wide crossing distances, lack of curb ramps, and limited visibility due to corner buildings and parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The zebra markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: No visible curb ramps at the crossing points, creating a barrier for people with mobility aids.

hazards.name: Restricted Sightlines
hazards.description: The building on the right corner and parked cars along the curb limit visibility between pedestrians and turning vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image and far curb
